comments: Contains an edit of the Climax Blues Band set at Reading 1983
Tommy mentions that he had a late one at a birthday party the previous evening (getting in at half four..PM!) settled down to watch Judas Priest on TV, then fell asleep!
The Nazareth track features in the film Performance but not performed by Nazareth!
Tom mentions that after the show he's off for a 'glass' of bubbly with Tony Wilson, who's birthday it is today!
Now a complete show - files b and c.
